videos.title: Cantilever Gate Video | Thomas Fence, Northwest Arkansas
videos.meta: Watch a Thomas Fence cantilever gate in motion and see why contractors choose cantilever over swing gates. Free quotes and financing. Call (479) 636-4732.
videos.hook: No track in the driveway means nothing to freeze, clog or wear.
videos.video_description: A Thomas Fence cantilever gate in motion, showing why most installers choose cantilever over swing gates for long-term reliability.
what: A cantilever gate slides sideways on rollers mounted behind the fence line, with nothing in the driveway to freeze, clog or wear.

With no bottom rail to collect debris or ice, it is a top choice for residential and commercial driveways. Thomas Fence has installed cantilever gates in Bentonville, Springdale and Fayetteville for commercial and residential entrances.
faq_specific: Why choose a cantilever gate over a swing gate?

A cantilever gate slides sideways on rollers mounted behind the fence line, so there is no track in the driveway to freeze, clog or wear, and it needs no swing space. A swing gate needs clear room for the gate to open.

Thomas Fence builds them in ornamental steel and custom entry styles on swing operators, an elegant choice for residential driveways with enough clearance for the gate to open.
faq_specific: Is a swing gate right for my driveway?

Swing gates suit residential driveways with enough clear space for the gate to open. Where that room is not available, a cantilever or pivot gate may fit better. Thomas Fence checks clearance during the site evaluation.

This custom pivot gate was engineered for a site where standard swing or slide options were not feasible. Pivot gates open from the center, ideal where a full swing arc or cantilever clearance is not available.
faq_specific: When is a pivot gate the right choice?
When a site has no room for a full swing arc or a slide track. A pivot gate lifts and turns on a single post, which suits self storage and industrial sites that open dozens of times a day.
